rationale: Measured from the 2026-07-18 Docker production client build after the five-stage seller onboarding, complete English/Dutch onboarding catalog, visible admin review queue, and detailed moderation-feedback handoff shipped. The Paraglide runtime remains isolated in an i18n chunk, keeping the largest entry chunk about 338 KiB below the pre-split measurement. The admin queue, localized review feedback, and corrected image/logout paths add about 7.3 KiB aggregate raw and 1.9 KiB aggregate gzip JavaScript over the previous reviewed baseline. Ceilings use fixed binary review units: 64 KiB for aggregate raw JavaScript, 16 KiB for aggregate gzip and initial raw JavaScript, 4 KiB for largest/initial/async gzip JavaScript and raw CSS, 16 KiB for largest raw and async JavaScript, and 1 KiB for gzip CSS. Initial JavaScript follows the Vite entry chunk's static import graph; async limits cover route and consent-gated chunks. The development-only Mollie route remains excluded from the production build.
